purpose: Hand-authored claims of which theories/<Module>.v are checked, by a differential test, against the ACTUAL shipped production OCaml — not merely against the extracted Rocq model in isolation. This is a distinct question from 'is it proven': every theorem in proof-ledger.json is proven either way. It is the backlog-201 answer to 'model vs production' for this project, made mechanical rather than left to README/STATUS prose. scripts/check-production-link.py verifies each entry below against the freshly generated ledger and the named test file's real content (production_call must appear as a live call, comments stripped — a stale claim whose test regressed must fail, not silently keep being cited).

TypeSafetySpec.note: T1-CMBT differential property (QCheck, 2000 random cases): asserts the extracted TypeSafetyModel.infer_type and the real Sarek_typer.infer agree, over the ELit/EVar/ELet/ETuple fragment the model covers. F-TS-01 (ELet scope leak) was found this way and is resolved.

UnifySpec.note: T2-UNIFY differential property (QCheck, 1000 random cases): asserts the extracted unifier and the real Sarek_types.unify agree, over ground (non-type-variable) types.
